channel.title: EU Black Sea — Maritime Security Monitor
channel.description: Reviewed maritime incidents and sourced public records relevant to Romania and Bulgaria

item.title: Gas Husky
item.description: Reported sinking east of Byala; cause not conclusively established.

item.title: Betul 8
item.description: Reported sinking off Cape Kaliakra; crew rescued.

item.title: EU meeting calls for stronger maritime security and protection of shipping
item.description: Co-chairs identified drone threats to shipping, the protection of maritime routes and progress toward a Black Sea Maritime Security Hub.

item.title: Evia Petrol V
item.description: Reported drone strike near Sulina; crew controlled fire.

item.title: Ali Najafov
item.description: Reported drone incident near Sulina; date varies by source.

item.title: Marsol
item.description: Reported strike near Sulina; fire extinguished.

item.title: Larissa 1
item.description: Reported damage near Sfântu Gheorghe.

item.title: Bulgaria links Black Sea security to European stability
item.description: Deputy Foreign Minister Hristo Polendakov addressed attacks on commercial vessels and a joint Bulgarian–Romanian maritime security centre.

item.title: Romania discusses Black Sea security hub and protection of trade routes
item.description: Romanian officials described cooperation with Bulgaria on a maritime security hub and the need to protect critical infrastructure and commercial supply routes.

item.title: Bulgaria outlines joint maritime security work with Romania
item.description: Foreign Minister Velislava Petrova discussed the proposed maritime security centre and cooperation with NATO and EU partners.

item.title: Contship Jet
item.description: Reported naval-drone attack and sinking offshore.

item.title: Bulgaria and France discuss Black Sea shipping safety
item.description: The foreign ministers discussed protecting civilian crews and coordination on maritime security.

item.title: Khoryv
item.description: Reported struck offshore near Constanța.

item.title: Wine Trader
item.description: Reported attack offshore near Sulina.

item.title: Yara J
item.description: Reported fire following incident near Sulina.

item.title: Chelsea 3
item.description: Reported struck by multiple drones; crew rescued.

item.title: HS Dignity
item.description: Reported sinking offshore near Shabla/Krapets.

item.title: Alfa Watan
item.description: Reported drone strike east of Byala; vessel sank.

item.title: Able
item.description: Damaged in reported attack near Alfa Watan.

item.title: Royad Mammadov
item.description: Struck offshore; two crew members reported killed.

item.title: AYA
item.description: Grain carrier damaged in Romania's exclusive economic zone. Ukraine attributed the strike to Russia; no casualties reported. Date is the reported time of impact (publicly announced September 12).

item.title: Naval mine — Pasha Dere
item.description: Bulgarian sailors found a mine-like object two nautical miles east of Pasha Dere; a minehunter crew classified it as a KPM-type mine and destroyed it in a controlled explosion.

item.title: Drone fragments — Plauru
item.description: Romanian investigators discovered elements potentially associated with drone fragments near Plauru on the evening of 5 September; later government statements discussed this incident.

item.title: Sea mine — Sfântu Gheorghe
item.description: Romanian military personnel conducted a dangerous intervention to neutralise a sea mine washed ashore at Sfântu Gheorghe.

item.title: Drifting sea mine — Cape Kochan
item.description: Bulgarian military specialists neutralised a floating moored-type mine after a sighting near Cape Kochan. A separate mine was reported at Tyulenovo during the same period.

item.title: Drifting sea mine — Constanța
item.description: A Turkish-flagged cargo vessel reported a drifting sea mine around 2.5 nautical miles from Constanța port’s northern breakwater.

item.title: Drifting sea mine — Eforie
item.description: EOD divers neutralised a mine drifting roughly two nautical miles off the Eforie coast.

item.title: Drifting sea mine — Varna offshore
item.description: Bulgarian Navy specialists destroyed a floating sea mine sighted on 30 June 2022 some 27 nautical miles east of the Kamchia river mouth, in the vicinity of Varna.

item.title: Drifting sea mine — Capu Midia
item.description: Romanian Naval Forces located and neutralised a drifting mine approximately 39 nautical miles off Capu Midia.
